paragraphs: Aurrigo designs, engineers and manufactures airside equipment and technology for international airports and airlines. Its stated specialty is automated ground handling technology for baggage and cargo operations.

A second part of the business is an automotive technology division that the company says was established in 1993. That division serves premium vehicle OEMs and global Tier 1 manufacturers. The work it lists on the site includes electric vehicle development. Wire harness design and manufacture is listed as well.

The parent company, Aurrigo International plc, presents itself as an international provider of smart airside solutions. It runs an investor centre that offers updates, performance reports, and insights. The company gives its address on Siskin Drive in Coventry.

quote.text: Aurrigo designs, engineers and manufactures smart airside solutions to international airports and airlines.
